QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] Gathering Allies
QuestInfo.0: On their way to Momijigaoka to meet Princess Sakuno, Hayato and Yukimori run across a group of Motonari soldiers who have been ambushed by Oda forces.
QuestInfo.1: On their way to Momijigaoka to meet Princess Sakuno, Hayato and Yukimori run across a group of Motonari soldiers who have been ambushed by Oda forces. They leap into the fray.
QuestInfo.2: On their way to Momijigaoka to meet Princess Sakuno, Hayato and Yukimori ran across a group of Motonari soldiers who were ambushed by Oda forces. After they lept into the fray, they had a brief meeting with Princess Sakuno.
